以為吃鈣片就能防骨折？15萬人研究揭真相 醫曝4招才保命 每天吃鈣片，就能預防骨質疏鬆、降低骨折風險嗎？重症科醫師黃軒指出，2026年5月發表於國際醫學期刊《BMJ》的一項大型研究，分析超過15萬名成年人，發現單獨補充鈣片或維生素D，並未證實能明顯降低整體骨折風險。即使鈣與維生素D一起補充，降低骨折風險的幅度也相當有限。他提醒，防骨折不能只靠補鈣，肌肉力量、平衡能力及骨質疏鬆治療同樣重要。 21 分鐘前｜健康 以為吃鈣片就能防骨折？15萬人研究揭真相 醫曝4招才保命 21 分鐘前｜健康
heads.en: You think you'll get a fracture if you eat a chip? One hundred and fifty thousand people are studying the truth, and it's four strokes to save their lives. According to a major study published in May 2026 in the International Journal of Medicine, BMJ, which analysed over 150,000 adults and found a single supplement to tablets or vitamin D, it has not been shown that it will significantly reduce the risk of a whole fracture. Even if platinum is added to the vitamin D, the risk of fracture is quite limited. He reminds that protection from fractures cannot be based solely on iron and that muscle strength, balancing power and osteoporosis are equally important. Twenty-one minutes ago, he was healthy and thought he'd be able to protect himself from fractures? One hundred and fifty thousand people are studying the truth.
